title: Unified reviewer drawer omits locked FFF assessment facts
expected: Reviewer UI visibly shows A0040-P06, Form suspected impact, Fit no impact, Function no impact, and both controlled files before decision.
actual: Reviewer UI showed the drawing, A0040-P06 and both files, but the ReviewContextProjection contained no FFF conclusion or Form/Fit/Function values.
root_cause: The primary approvals route uses UnifiedPdmEntityDetailDrawer, while the prior repair rendered FFF facts only in the legacy ApprovalDetailDrawer.
fix: Projected the same locked legacy review evidence into ReviewContextProjection and rendered FFF, affected parts, and submitted files.
